ir.name: pairwise_pref_loss
ir.intuition: This loss encourages the model to prefer higher-quality outputs by comparing the log probabilities of paired samples, weighted by a cost gap as a measure of preference. By taking the difference in log probabilities scaled by the cost gap, we promote higher probability assignments to better options, aligning with preference learning in RL4CO.
ir.pseudocode: loss = mean over batch of -logsigmoid((log_prob_w - log_prob_l) * weight)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    log_prob_w = batch["log_prob_w"]
    log_prob_l = batch["log_prob_l"]
    weight = batch["weight"]
    cost_gap = batch.get("cost_gap", ops.zeros_like(log_prob_w))
    # Compute score differences scaled by cost_gap
    score_diff = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) * cost_gap
    # Compute preference based on sigmoid
    pref = ops.logsigmoid(score_diff)
    # Average over batch
    loss = -ops.mean(pref)
    return loss
